title: 有馬記念の後に・限界の果て

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon has surpassed her body's limit, fulfilling her grand dream of reaching her full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a while, she's flooded with emotion, but upon realizing she's achieved her goal, she bursts into laughter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While racing, Manhattan Cafe saw in Agnes Tachyon the shadow of the person whom she's been chasing. This further piques Tachyon's interest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to have found a new test subject. A deviant grin spreads across her face as her mind plunges into a sea of wild ideas.
